subject: AcmeHealth security onboarding — SIG prefill & a couple scope clarifications
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 03 Apr 2027 16:10:00 -0700
Subject: AcmeHealth security onboarding — SIG prefill & a couple scope clarifications

Hi Olivia,

Thanks again for the call earlier — good to meet you and Josh. Quick recap + next steps so we have the right scope for the vendor security questionnaire (SIG/CAIQ):

- Redwood will complete the security intake prefill and share a single SIG spreadsheet for your security team to review.
- We want to confirm whether AcmeHealth prefers the full SIG or SIG Lite/CAIQ for initial review (happy to do a crosswalk once you pick).
- A few quick clarifying questions that will change evidence asks and timeline:
  1) Does AcmeHealth expect Redwood to attest to coverage of ePHI/PHI (HIPAA)? In our call you mentioned some workflows ingest claims data — can you confirm whether that data is considered ePHI in scope?
  2) SOC 2: what timeline are you comfortable with? You mentioned SOC 2 in progress — is there an expected completion quarter?
  3) Data retention & deletion: suggested retention window for telemetry/usage logs you need (e.g., 90 days, 1 year)?

If you can confirm the answers to (1)-(3) it will help us limit the evidence set and give you an estimated turnaround for prefill + evidence (we typically return a prefilled SIG + evidence roadmap in ~3 business days if SOC 2 coverage/EHR connections are straightforward).

Attached: provisional prefill template (blank) so you can see the columns we populate.

Proposed next steps:
- You confirm ePHI/SOC 2/retention answers in reply.
- We return a filled SIG sheet + list of available evidence artifacts and an estimated delivery date.
- If helpful, schedule a 30-min follow-up with our security engineer (Karthik) to walk a few architecture diagrams.

Would love confirmation on whether you prefer SIG or SIG Lite to start.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com | (415) 555-0198

Attachment: Acme_SIG_prefill_questions.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)
From: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@acmehealth.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Josh Peters <josh.peters@acmehealth.com>
Date: Sun, 04 Apr 2027 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AcmeHealth security onboarding — SIG prefill & a couple scope clarifications

Thanks Vanessa — appreciated the clear recap. A few answers inline: 

1) ePHI/HIPAA: Yes — AcmeHealth considers the patient-identifiable claims data as ePHI when it includes patient identifiers (name, MRN, etc.). For the pilot we plan to pass tokenized patient ids only, but long-term there will be some flows with PHI. So HIPAA coverage is required; please include HIPAA controls in the SIG scope.

2) SOC 2: We are targeting vendors who either have SOC 2 Type II already or will complete it by Q4 2027. We understand pre-SOC vendors are acceptable for pilots but full procurement requires SOC 2 by contract signature for production.

3) Retention: For telemetry we need a minimum of 180 days; for raw logs that include tokenized ids we can accept 90 days if encrypted.

Regarding SIG vs CAIQ: for legal we prefer the full SIG spreadsheet first, then a short CAIQ variant if we need a faster summary for product reviewers.

I attached a redacted network diagram that shows the pilot dataflow — hope that helps your engineer.

Happy to have Karthik join a walkthrough next week. Can you do Wed 4/7 10am PT?

Best,
Olivia Chen
Head of IT Security, AcmeHealth
olivia.chen@acmehealth.com

Attachment: acme_network_diagram_redacted.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Apr 2027 09:32:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AcmeHealth security onboarding — SIG prefill & a couple scope clarifications

Hi Olivia — thanks for the fast responses and for the diagram, that is helpful. Quick answers and what we'll send next: 

- HIPAA: noted. We'll scope the SIG to include HIPAA-relevant controls and highlight the control mappings for ePHI flows. We'll also include our KMS/HSM coverage and evidence pointers for encryption at rest/in transit.
- SOC 2: we will mark SOC 2 as "in progress" and include our current Type I/attestation timeline in the notes. We'll flag any control gaps that would be required for a Q4 completion.
- Retention: we'll propose the following in the evidence roadmap: telemetry 180 days, raw logs with tokenization 90 days (encrypted). If legal requires stricter SLAs we can itemize options.

Action items from Redwood (I'll own delivery):
1) Attach: completed SIG prefill (Acme_SIG_prefill_questions.xlsx) with answers + evidence catalog (estimating 3 business days).
2) Schedule technical walkthrough: Wed 7 Apr 2027, 10:00 AM PT — suggested invite coming from Karthik.
3) Provide a short write-up explaining how we handle ePHI tokenization and deletion for the pilot (will include retention config options).

If that works I'll send the prefill now and follow up with the calendar invite.

Thanks — looking forward to the walkthrough.

Best,
Monica Patel
Security Solutions Manager | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com
